full_name: Chad L. Williams | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2017–2018 Humanities Evelyn Green Davis Fellow Brandeis University
bio: At Radcliffe, Chad L. Williams is completing a book about W. E. B. Du Bois’s attempts to write what he believed would be the definitive history of African Americans in World War I. Based on Du Bois’s unpublished manuscript and research materials, the project explores how the personal, political, and historical legacies of World War I haunted both Du Bois and black people more broadly throughout the interwar period.
